title: Service plumbing
what: The service's settings in layers, its HTTP routes behind the bearer token with each route registered beside its answer and kebab-case refusals, the SQLite store, health and the binary's commands, in src/http.rs, settings.rs, store.rs, health.rs, lib.rs and main.rs.

title: Wire types and client
what: The bodies and queries every route takes and answers in the common wire format, and the service's own Rust client with one method per route, in src/wire.rs and src/client.rs.

title: Event stream
what: The service's one event stream, GET /events: entry and share changes kept in the store, the last 10,000, handed out live as server-sent events or as pages, in src/events.rs.

title: Harness plugin and OpenAPI document
what: The ahas-drive plugin: the MCP server bmo-drive mcp with the nine drive_ tools over the client and its skill, and the OpenAPI document generated from the wire types, in src/mcp/, src/openapi.rs and skills/.
